tool_description: ReSolve uses Google Gemini through three surfaces. (1) Gemini Advanced (Google AI Pro plan) is a consumer-facing conversational AI assistant accessed via web and mobile, providing text generation, summarization, research, and image generation via Imagen. Because it operates under consumer terms, users must manually disable “Gemini Apps Activity” to prevent data from being used for model training. (2) The Gemini API (Google AI Studio, generativelanguage.googleapis.com) provides programmatic access to Gemini models under Google APIs Terms of Service; the paid tier does not use data for model training and Google acts as data processor, though compliance certifications are not independently documented for this endpoint. (3) The Vertex AI Gemini API is the enterprise-grade endpoint under full Google Cloud terms, governed by the Cloud Data Processing Addendum (CDPA) with the strongest contractual protections and compliance certifications. Use of all three surfaces is restricted to corporate devices only, per ReSolve’s AI policy in Orion.

data_protection.details: Consumer plan: Gemini Apps Activity is ON by default and may use conversations to improve AI models. Users must manually toggle off “Gemini Apps Activity” to opt out. Even with Activity off, conversations are retained up to 72 hours and a subset may be human-reviewed (retained up to 3 years, disconnected from account).

Paid tier: Google does not use prompts or responses to improve products. Google acts as data processor under a Data Processing Addendum. Abuse-flagged content may still be reviewed by authorized Google employees. Free tier must not be used (data is used for model training).

Disabled by default. Google contractually commits not to use customer data to train or fine-tune AI/ML models without prior permission, per the CDPA and Service Specific Terms §17 (Training Restriction).
TLS 1.2/1.3 via BoringSSL; FIPS 140-3 Level 1 validated. Applies to all three surfaces.
AES-256 at the storage layer; FIPS 140-2 validated. Vertex AI additionally supports Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) in US and EU regions.
Conversations retained per auto-delete setting (default 18 months; options: 3, 18, or 36 months). With Activity off, up to 72 hours. Temporary Chat mode available for ephemeral sessions.
55-day retention for abuse monitoring (all tiers). 24-hour in-memory cache (RAM only). Zero Data Retention available upon request; does not apply to Grounding with Google Search (30-day retention).
24-hour in-memory TTL (disablable at project level). Zero-retention exceptions available. Grounding with Google Search retains data for 30 days.
Gemini Advanced and Gemini API: no user-configurable data residency. Vertex AI API: regional endpoints available (US, EU, and 15+ global regions) with guaranteed processing locality.
Vertex AI: full Google Cloud IAM, audit logging, and VPC Service Controls. Gemini API: API key or OAuth-based access. Gemini Advanced: individual user-level settings only.
